reconciliation_policy.crosswalk: Drive LC IDs, GitHub LC-R IDs, and SOURCE feature rows are separate catalogs; links only through explicit IDEA-LC references, never by numeric coincidence.

journey.acceptance: User identity comes from authenticated session; unauthorized calls rejected.
Same chat persists, reconnect recovers, later turns accepted after failure.
Persisted agent readback matches effective AgentClient configuration.

journey.source: LibreChat native memory/files/RAG + NOSTROMO context adapter
journey.acceptance: Measured token budget fits and persistent sources remain retrievable under ACL.

journey.functions: Classify conversation, research, visualization, target read, clarify
journey.acceptance: Ambiguity yields clarification; classification alone grants no effect.

journey.functions: Choose lane and require task agreement for material actions
journey.acceptance: R2 path cannot start without authenticated agreement and target permission.

journey.functions: Select model/provider by capability, context, privacy, health, quota and cost
journey.acceptance: Only fresh eligible routes admitted; no silent paid fallback.

journey.functions: SIWC consented plan, verified free providers, local Ollama on demand
journey.acceptance: Provider/model evidence is LIVE-read, consent-scoped and not inferred from model names.
Use only necessary tools with provenance; no remote DOM trust.
UI state is projection; hiding a panel does not change backend truth or authorization.

journey.functions: Clarify objective and obtain owner agreement
journey.acceptance: Agreement is bound to owner/session/hash and expires or revokes.
Plan vs scheduled vs materially verified are separate states.

journey.functions: One productive MCP and explicit external target adapters
journey.acceptance: Only registered tools appear; authority boundaries remain independent.
R2 requires the destination plane’s exact grant; no cross-plane substitution.

journey.functions: Receipts, readback and explicit status truth
journey.acceptance: Change→test→readback→verify; no PASS from assertion or fixture.

journey.functions: Recovery, reboot checkpoint, restore and GitHub/Drive sync
journey.acceptance: Checkpoint is recoverable; reboot has a distinct post-boot verification receipt.

GitHub source matrix has 39 features and intentionally no stable feature IDs; SRC numbers are only row locators.
Owner hints in Drive are taken from its Dependency column and are not authority/assignment proof.
Acceptance rules are documented constraints; runtime acceptance still requires the linked test/readback, and a source test is not LIVE verification.
No complete crosswalk exists for items without explicit shared IDEA-LC references; gaps remain visible.

contradictions_and_limits.resolution: Keep all IDs and catalogs separate; use only explicit IDEA-LC cross-references.

contradictions_and_limits.finding: The Drive capability spreadsheet was last modified 2026-10-07; SPEC and TOPOLOGY use 2026-10-08 source cut and branch HEAD 9495451…, while current E3 GitHub HEAD is later.
contradictions_and_limits.resolution: Treat these files as design/provenance sources, not current branch/runtime readbacks.

contradictions_and_limits.resolution: Use issue #56 and current repository/host receipts for newer status; do not overwrite historical statements.
